signature: Assert.Inconclusive failed. Can't set Console foreground color
cause: By design, and not a skip. OutputExtensionsTests.cs:149 calls Assert.Inconclusive when the console foreground colour cannot be set, and MSTest maps Inconclusive to NotExecuted. The tests RUN - durations of 3, 4, 33 and 84 ms prove it - and then declare themselves inconclusive on a redirected-output agent. Signature taken from the TRX; the ADO results API reports errorMessage as null for these rows, which is why an earlier version of this entry expected no message at all.
